about: Read by job-weekly's update_check.py to tell people a newer version exists. Information only: nothing here is run.

versions.summary: Interview debriefs and proof packs, overclaiming checks on CVs, negotiation lines and rehearsal, applications by email, Job Seek as a job source, and automatic updates.
helps: a debrief after each real interview and a question bank that shapes the next round
a one-page proof pack before each interview, checked against your evidence
CVs can't quietly upgrade 'contributed to' into 'led', or call work published when it's under review
set your ask, accept and walk-away lines before negotiating, and rehearse the call
applications by email when a posting says 'send your CV to'
jobs from thousands more company career pages through Job Seek
updates that arrive and apply themselves, asking only when you're needed

versions.summary: Referral path, Google people search, contact checks before any draft.
helps: find people on a team through Google without going on LinkedIn
a referral path: hello, thank-you, the ask, one nudge, stop
warnings before writing to someone unverified or to a recruiter who just rejected you
